integrity: Exact enumerator follows from block congruence and finite-field rank counts; bounded exhaustive direct-field enumeration is supporting evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Only independent uniform entries on the complete split graph permitted symmetric matrix pattern are counted; off-diagonal entries may be zero. The limit fixes the field order. No finite-size Berry–Esseen estimate or arbitrary sparse-pattern universality is claimed. The finite-field symmetric rank formula is a known ingredient; priority against unindexed equivalent block formulas is unresolved.
title: Complete nullity census and a Gaussian invertibility threshold for finite-field split-pattern matrices
